name: Antonius "Anthony" Landkammer

Angelówka, Bezirk Brody, Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria, Austria-Hungary

notes:
Refer to obituary for Reginald James Landkamer.

Anthony (Tony) Landkammer and brother George Landkammer immigrated to Canada.  Brother John Landkammer immigrated to the USA and settled in St. Paul, Minn. Brother Andrew Landkammer did not immigrate from the old country.

Anthony's gravesite is just to the south of the entrance, very near the road and close to the large white statuary in the Holy Ghost Cemetery.  It is a double headstone (with Rosalia Aker) and is tan coloured. See also message for Rosalia Aker.

Anthony was also known as Anton. See Winnipeg Free Press obituary for Anton Landkammer, which also names sister Marie German (Maria Landkammer?).

-Allan Zelmer
